steps.prompt: You've refreshed algebra, geometry, counting and number theory, and found your danger zones. What score are you aiming for in Mock C?

cards.title: Trust your plan
cards.body: By now your pacing plan should feel natural. In Mock C, watch for your danger zones: when you meet one, slow down for ten seconds and check the trap before you answer.

cards.title: Mistake analysis
cards.body: After the mock, open your result and sort every miss and blank into one of four boxes: (1) I didn't know the idea, (2) a careless slip, (3) I misread the question, (4) I ran out of time. Add the problems you didn't know to your error log, and look at the review by strand and by difficulty: is one strand weak, or do the points leak away in the last ten problems?

cards.title: Your AMC-score estimate
cards.body: After this mock, your progress page has an estimate built from your last three full tests (mocks, checkpoints and logged past papers), with a range. It is a guide, not a promise: a good night's sleep moves it too.

prompts: Did you spot any of your danger-zone traps in time?
How does Mock C compare with Mocks A and B?
